Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Jeff Siegal <siegal@rintintin.Colorado.EDU> wrote:
> i realized this has been discussed to death but for a final announcement I
>need to know when voting on a bloodhunt(from diablerie) do:
>1>methuselahs get to vote(for being a meth.)
>	I know they don't for normal voting

Methuselahs never get a vote simply for existing.  They must get votes
from something in the game.

>2>methuselahs get votes from vote cards in their hand
>	ie. political action cards)

You can burn policial cards for votes during any vote, including a bloodhunt.
You can also trade in the edge during any vote.

>3>methuselahs get to vote from surprise influence cards(reation cards)
>	I know this is wrong because it says so in the rules very clearly.

You are reading the rulebook correctly; using reaction cards (and action
modifiers) is illegal during a bloodhunt vote.

>4>Ready vampires that are primogen/prince/justicar get votes?

They will give you votes during any vote, yes.



Basically, only modifiers and reactions are illegal during the bloodhunt
vote.  All other means of garnering votes are fine.
